input.title: BoundaryInput
input.description: What a caller is about to write somewhere, put to the check.

destination.description: Where it is going. Anything but `public` passes without a term being read.

metadata.description: Branch names, titles, commit messages and every other short field.

scope.description: Which private repositories the terms come from.

output.title: BoundaryVerdict
output.description:
What the check decided.

The public-facing half carries no term, no identity and no path: a refusal says
*where* a term was found and nothing about which. The detail is
[`Evidence`], which only a caller that supplied somewhere private to put it gets.

oneOf.description: Nothing private was found, or the destination is not public.
A private term was found.
The check could not decide, and the write must not go ahead.

Surface.description:
Where in a write a private term was found — the whole of what a refusal says
about it.
